# Setup

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
set.seed(23)
```

## Load Data

Load matrices computed on AMD and Intel CPUs.

```{r}
amd <- read.csv(file = paste0("amd_", params$pca, ".csv")) |> as.matrix()
intel <- read.csv(file = paste0("intel_", params$pca, ".csv")) |> as.matrix()
```

Compare differences.

```{r}
diff <- amd - intel
range(diff)

n_dim <- ncol(diff)
n_cells <- nrow(diff)

diff <- diff |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cell = 1:n_cells) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("PC_")) |>
  mutate(pc = str_remove(name, "PC_")) |>
  mutate(pc = as.integer(pc))

diff <- diff |> 
  mutate(range_pc = cut(pc, 
                        breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
                        include.lowest = TRUE))

# distribution
ggplot(diff, aes(value, group = pc, color = pc)) +
  geom_freqpoly(bins = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~range_pc, scales = "free")

# mean and sd
diff |>
  group_by(pc, range_pc) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(value), 
            sd = sd(value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc, mean)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - 1.96*sd, ymax = mean + 1.96*sd)) +
  facet_wrap(~range_pc, scales = "free")

# median and quantiles
diff |> 
  group_by(pc, range_pc) |>
  summarize(median = median(value), 
            low = quantile(value, 0.05),
            high = quantile(value, 0.95)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc, median)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high)) +
  facet_wrap(~range_pc, scales = "free")
```
